method: ARRIVAL (explicit | implicit | negative) x TASK (query | migration | model | RLS | question about the data). Positives touch the real schema; negatives are data-model or migration-strategy commitments (architecture), database-free work, and a schema already checked this session.

cases.prompt: Before you write the query, check the real schema of orders and invoices.
Aggiungi un filtro per stato sulla lista ordini, la colonna dovrebbe chiamarsi status.
Write a migration that adds a discount_pct column to quote_lines.
Perché il campo trace_id è sempre null nelle fatture?
Add an RLS policy so users only update their own quotes.
Does the clients table have an email column? Check, don't guess.
Should quotes and orders share one table or two? We need to decide the data model.
Change the button color on the settings page to our brand blue.
Plan the expand/contract order for renaming customer to client across three services.
